name: Seris Order Manager
author: Faveren Caleb

sections.description:
Seris Order Manager supercharges your WooCommerce order processing. This powerful plugin effortlessly generates customized PDF receipts and packing slips for your orders, complete with QR codes and barcodes for efficient tracking and verification .

Streamline your fulfillment workflow by generating documents individually or in bulk directly from the WooCommerce orders page. Enhance the post-purchase experience with a fully customizable frontend section that lets customers confirm their delivery, automatically updating the order status. The plugin adds a dedicated “Shipped” status, helping you clearly differentiate between delivered and in-transit orders .

With seamless WooCommerce integration and support for various paper sizes, Seris Order Manager provides a professional, scalable solution for stores of all sizes.

Why Choose Seris Order Manager?

  • Professional packing & Receipts – Generate customized receipts and packing slips that build customer trust and brand recognition
  • Smart QR Code & Barcode Tracking – Every document includes scannable codes for instant order verification and inventory management
  • Streamlined Order Status Workflow – Added “Shipped” status keeps customers informed throughout the delivery process
  • Mobile-Friendly Design – All documents work perfectly on desktop and mobile devices
  • Enhances Shopping Experience – Moves a step a way from the completed status to deferentiate delivered orders from other orders.
  • Zero Learning Curve – Setup takes minutes and works seamlessly with your existing WooCommerce store

Features

  • Custom Receipt & Packing Slip Generation

    • Brand with your logo and company details
    • Professional formatting for 2 1/4″ and 2 1/2″ receipt paper
    • Clean packing slips optimized for 4×6″ labels

  • Advanced Order Tracking

    • Automated QR code generation for every order
    • Barcode support for inventory management
    • Mobile-scannable codes for delivery verification

  • Customer Delivery Confirmation

    • Frontend confirmation button for customers
    • Customizable button classes and styling
    • Reduces “false missing package” claims

  • Bulk Printing Capabilities

    • Print multiple orders simultaneously
    • Save time on daily order processing
    • Streamlined batch operations

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration

    • Adds “Shipped” order status automatically
    • Works with existing WooCommerce workflows
    • No additional apps or services required

sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option — WordPress will handle the file transfer, and you won’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”

In the search field type “Seris Order Manager” then click “Search Plugins.” Once you’ve found us, you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by! Click “Install Now,” and WordPress will take it from there.

Manual installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the Seris Order Manager plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.
sections.faq:
What paper sizes are supported for printing?

The plugin supports standard thermal paper sizes including 2 1/4″, 2 1/2″, A4 and custom paper size for receipts, and 4×6″ for packing slips. All templates are optimized for these dimensions.

What does the custom paper size mean?

This paper size supports another other paper size that is not in the options. Just enter the width in mm of the paper size you want and the template adjusts to that size.

What is the custom Thank you message for?

The custom Thank you message appears at the buttom of the receipt. You can write any message for your customers.

How do i make my logo appear colored?

For colored logos use .png format. Other format appear in black and white. Also ensure your printer can print in color.

Can customers really confirm delivery themselves?

Yes! The plugin adds a frontend confirmation button that lets customers verify they’ve received their order. This seperates delivered orders and orders that are yet to be delivered.

Is the confirm deliver section customizable?

Yes, copy the css code from the settings page and paste into the additional css in Appearance > customise and adjust to what you want.

How do I print in Bulk?

To print receipts or packing slip in bulk navigate to the bulk printing page Woocommerce > Bulk print order then select the orders you want to bulk print, then click on Generate receipts or Generate packing Slips

How do QR codes help my business?

QR codes provide instant order verification for you and your customers. They can be scanned to pull up order details, track packages, and verify deliveries without manual lookups.

Is this compatible with my existing WooCommerce theme?

Absolutely! The plugin works with any standard WooCommerce installation and is compatible with most popular themes. The frontend elements follow your theme’s styling.

Does this work with other WooCommerce plugins?

The plugin is designed to work alongside most WooCommerce extensions. If you encounter any conflicts, please contact support.
